info.name: Rings
info.description: Magical Rings from Arcana Unleashed: Deadfall

description.p: While wearing this simple metal band, you gain a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Insight) checks. In addition, you can cast Zone of Truth (save DC 13) from the ring. You can't cast Zone of Truth in this way again until the next dawn.

setters.set: wisdom, insight, checks, zone of truth, dawn
